record.question: The superintendent of Excise & Narcotics are empowered to grant leave of absence to Ministerial staff serving under them for upto one month, provided that:
options: The leave does not exceed six months in the calendar year
The leave is due under the Fundamental Rules
The leave is recommended by the Deputy Commissioner of the district concerned
The leave is sanctioned only after the approval of the Commissioner in every case.
